envelope.description: Hold completion inside the completion walk

body.title: Hold completion inside the completion walk
body.summary: Add the optional holds predicate to EvidenceContext, consult it for every unit completeIfRolledUp visits so the walk stops at a held Story and therefore its Epic, and pass signoffHoldsCompletion from completeThroughService in gates.ts.
acceptanceChecks: With no predicate the walk behaves exactly as before
A held Story is left approved and the Epic above it is not completed
An unheld Story completes and the walk stops at a held Epic
completeThroughService leaves a Story approved while its listed BUILD awaits signoff

tests.name: src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/completion-holds.test.ts: completeIfRolledUp with a holds predicate stops the walk at a held Story so the Epic is not completed, completes an unheld Story and then stops at a held Epic, and with no predicate behaves as before
src/workflow/__tests__/signoff-hold.test.ts: completeThroughService leaves a Story approved-not-completed while its listed BUILD awaits signoff
